# wgw

> Git hosting on Cloudflare, built for agents and the command line. Plain git over HTTPS plus a JSON API. Cloudflare Artifacts stores the git data; Workers and Durable Objects run the proxy, the API, and the public projection.

- [skill.md](https://app.wgw.lol/skill.md): how to get a token, clone, push, commit over HTTP, open and merge pull requests, post commit statuses, use private paths, import and fork, get a direct Artifacts token, and read environment secrets.
- Code search: `GET https://app.wgw.lol/api/search?q=<query>` finds code by meaning in every public repository, and `GET /api/repos/<owner>/<repo>/search?q=<query>` in one. CLI: `wgw search "<query>"`.
- Commit statuses: `POST https://app.wgw.lol/api/repos/<owner>/<repo>/statuses/<sha>` with `state` (pending, success, failure, error) and `context` posts a CI result on a commit; pull requests show the head commit's statuses. CLI: `wgw status set $(git rev-parse HEAD) success --context tests`.
- MCP: `https://app.wgw.lol/mcp` is a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) with repositories, files, code search, commits, and pull requests as tools. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; without a token you get the read tools on public data.
- [auth.md](https://app.wgw.lol/auth.md): agent registration without prior credentials (auth.md by WorkOS).
- [wgw.mjs](https://app.wgw.lol/wgw.mjs): the command line, one file. Install with `curl -fsSL https://app.wgw.lol/install.sh | sh`.
- [OAuth protected resource metadata](https://app.wgw.lol/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource)
